decisions.reason: The data format plug-ins extend the firm's core data integration expertise and its standards work, so feedback is easy to interpret and the product can be refined continuously in-house.
The building digital twin rests on a newer BIM knowledge base and gets only a brief web mention, but it fits the strategic direction and the firm's research ties can strengthen it.

Authentication and identity delegation is close to the firm's security components, though it overlaps with the broader identity service and could be merged into it, which raises the risk of withdrawal.
The identity service for GIS applications draws directly on the firm's platform integration know-how and was actively promoted at launch, so continued development is likely.
The geodata business process consulting workshop builds on decades of consulting and training experience, has its own page, and lets the firm absorb customer needs directly.
